caption: Cat communication comparison: Humphrey et al. (2020), Supplementary Information 3 video. Click video to play.
teaching_context: Publisher-supplied human–cat slow-blink demonstration provides a nonthreatening communication comparison. It is not footage of the Quaranta anger/hissing/purring experiment described in the original slide. Slow blinking is the repeated narrowing and closing of the eyes. The primary study compared cat eye responses and approach behavior after human slow blinking with control conditions.
